claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Somatostatin is a short-lived peptide hormone with no intrinsic cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any weak effects reflecting non-specific peptide/physicochemical perturbation rather than a defined killing mechanism.
